## About

The last twenty seconds of a maker channel's video, laid out for the platform's end-screen
elements: two 16:9 slots with rounded corners and an inner white stroke where the watch-next
videos will appear, and a round pink channel badge (an ellipse with a stroke and a three-sided
polygon turned 90° as its play mark) beside the subscribe prompt. Behind it the city footage
is softened with Gaussian Blur (36, repeat edge pixels) and a navy shade.
